summary: When one of Nora's own reminders comes due, she now thinks before deciding whether to say anything, so she stops repeating a plan the group already settled or a question she asked minutes ago.
details: The proactive turn has its own `[proactive] reasoning_effort`, `low` by default; it used to share `[participation]`'s `none`.
On the proactive_act eval suite (5 draws per case) she stayed silent where silence was right 32 times in 40, up from 8, and spoke where she should 8 times in 10, down from 10.
limitations: The case that most often goes quiet when it should speak is a follow-up she still owes someone (3 of 5).
Each proactive turn now writes about 4,000 more reasoning tokens.
